python3 - <<'PY'
from PIL import Image
img=Image.open('/workspace/.tmp/agent_shots/cassette-settings.png')
w,h=img.size
crop=img.crop((0,110,w,650))
out='/workspace/.tmp/agent_shots/cassette-settings-region.png'
crop.save(out)
print('saved',out,'size',crop.size)
PY
